value.title: dd-native builder — the structural proof graph, wired end to end
value.summary: Wire the dd proof graph end to end: dd-native plans and tasks, typed rels, semantic validate, mechanically-refused phase departures.

sections.name: research_context
sections.value:
Direct continuation of plan 065 (shipped, PR #87): the dd document layer, builder/* schemas, exemplar corpus, and flow-spine departure gate all exist and are tested — but nothing drives them (zero dd_links in any flight plan; builder has no dd knowledge).

Design authority: the 2026-08-04 Jordan/koala session, recorded as a RULED/LEAN/OPEN ledger in docs/plans/065-deterministic-documents/builder-tuning/notes.md and the design doc structural-proof-graph.md beside it. An independent Opus validation pass (NEEDS ATTENTION, 10 findings F1–F10) was folded in — all ten addressed, the load-bearing ones promoted to Key Findings.

Plan #90 (merged) moved builder in-repo (skills/builder/), introduced the assets/ layout, the 7b post-flight stage, and plan archiving — constraints this plan lands inside.

This plan is itself the first dd-native plan: this document IS the dogfood, and authoring it forced the schema extension it rides on (full builder spec as schema sections) plus one recorded difficulty (the CLI-frozen id-prefix registry).

sections.name: summary
sections.value:
Make the builder pipeline dd-native, 100%: plans and per-phase task files are authored as .dd.json (humans read the generated sibling — there is no -plan.md), the flight-plan template and expander author the dd_link gates, and navigation is mechanically refused when the documents say the work is not done.

Around that spine: typed link relations (a frozen five with machine semantics), the per-item links bucket, mandatory pressure on every assertion, the satisfies edge from tasks to the ACs they serve, a semantic validation layer (harness plan validate) with contradiction warnings, scoped proof-tree reads, and a strict-zero --complete mode, plus a PR surface that renders closed ACs with their resolved evidence for the human checkpoint.

The thesis: the graph does not make claims true — it makes false claims expensive and visible. Agents run the journey autonomously; humans review claims-with-evidence at the PR.

sections.name: goals
value: Typed link relations: semantics on the rel, not the field name; five built-ins frozen (pressure, proven_by, satisfies, derives, ref); unknown rels legal, treated as ref.
Every list item can carry a links bucket (list-typed rel ref), auto-rendered as a final table column when present, traversed by dd graph map.

Every done_when assertion names its instrument: pressure is a BP-row link or the literal not-applicable; absence is a validation ERROR. BP rows are a toolbelt — no state, no coverage reading, they gate nothing.
evidence sections become done_when (the dw- prefix already says so).
Task rows carry satisfies (always an array) back to the ACs they serve.

harness plan validate grows the semantic layer: open-completables summary (info), rel-generic contradiction warnings (always), --address scoping (the proof-subgraph read), and --complete mode (per-row opens + orphan ACs + strict-zero green).

The flow gains a check-kind gate: the last review node refuses departure until plan validate --complete is green; phase nodes gate on their task sections; the builder template/expander authors all of it.
1b plan and 5 tasks author .dd.json natively — the plan document is plan.dd.json with its generated sibling, no -plan.md exists; ship renders the dd-derived AC/evidence table into the PR body.
The dd command surface is taught positionally: baked into node instructions[] and each stage module at its seam.

Self-hosting: by ship, plan 071's OWN corpus is fully retrofitted — real gates hit during the journey, real validations, backpressure and log linked — indistinguishable from a plan authored entirely by the finished feature.

The flow evaluates its own delivery: the flow-eval harness extension (and its prompting) gains a single-phase dd-native scenario — a blind subject runs the new builder flow end-to-end and telemetry-scored assertions prove it used the tooling correctly.

sections.name: non_goals
value: No probe execution anywhere in dd/plan surfaces (ruled, twice): harness checks owns instrument execution; validate reads the record.
No AC-state derivation — closure stays a performed act (agents close; the guard rails make it trustworthy).
No code-drift freshness beyond the existing basis ledger (ruled: solve when it bites).
No migration of existing markdown plans (058–069 stay as they are; the archive is institutional memory, not a conversion backlog).
No per-assertion satisfies (ruled: task row, coarse).
No allowlist/policy surface for --complete warnings (ruled: strict zero; --force is the bypass).
No changes to the five lifecycle hooks, the harness-seam doctrine, or the E44x gate codes' meanings.
No multi-phase flow-eval scenario in this plan — single-phase first; multi-phase considered later.

value.approach: Hybrid — TDD for the new dd-core logic (rel parsing, contradiction engine, --complete/--address predicates, check-gate evaluator); lightweight validation for renderer columns, skill prompt-ware, and PR body assembly.
value.rationale: The correctness heart feeds gates other systems trust; wiring follows exercised patterns.
value.focus_areas: Control discipline (house rule: a check only ever run against good input has been demonstrated, not tested): every new warning/error class gets a planted-bad fixture proving it FIRES, plus a good twin; the pre-JIT target-invalid refusal pinned as intended behaviour; legacy markdown read path pinned over a legacy-folder fixture. Synthetic-corpus discipline: a shared fixture factory builds mock plans/phases/task files, and lifecycle-mutation suites drive them through the journey's state transitions (tick, untick, block, human-skip, JIT-birth of task files, basis drift) asserting validator and gate behaviour at every step — unit-level proof across the mutation space, not just point fixtures.
value.excluded: Pixel-level markdown cosmetics beyond structural goldens; probe execution (out of scope by ruling).
value.mock_usage: Fake ports only (injected fake-fs/clock; no vi.mock); real fixture corpora extending the exemplar. Prompt-ware behaviour proven by the scripted end-to-end dry-run (create → JIT → refuse → green → depart) at the P3+P4 join, with the CLI as the actor.

value.location: docs/how/dd/ chapters extended in place (relations, done_when, satisfies, links bucket, --complete/--address); structural-proof-graph.md promotes from builder-tuning/ into docs/how/dd/ once schemas land; baked dd docs regenerated via gen:dd-docs wherever the schema surface changes.
value.rationale: Agents discover dd through the CLI (dd docs, orient instructions[], refusal next_actions); humans get the deep reference in docs/how/dd/. ac-7116 makes the builder flow itself teach the commands positionally.

value.claim:
Pressure mandatory: in the builder/done_when schema, an assertion without pressure is a validation ERROR (planted-bad fixture proves it fires);
pressure not-applicable validates, renders honestly, and is queryable (a stock jq one-liner lists every not-applicable assertion — documented).

done_when rename: builder schemas and the exemplar use done_when (unchanged dw- ids); renderer titles read naturally; no evidence-named section remains in living builder schemas; frozen historical corpora are signposted, not rewritten.
satisfies: task rows carry satisfies as an always-array of rel-typed links to AC rows; dd graph map on an AC shows the incoming work-accounting; a non-array satisfies fails validation.

--complete mode: adds per-row warnings for every open completable and every orphan AC (no incoming satisfies); green means zero errors and zero warnings; without --complete, opens appear only as a summary info line; envelope semantics follow house degrade rules.

Template authors the gates: the template + expander emit dd_links — each phase node gating on assets/tasks/phase-N/tasks.dd.json#tasks (bare ordinal — a stated dd-native amendment to #90's phase-N-<kebab-title> convention: a static template can bake an ordinal address before titles exist, and retitling a phase must never move its task-file address), the last review node carrying the check gate;
a pre-JIT departure refuses target-invalid, pinned by test.

Legacy read path retained: dd-native is the only write path; the legacy markdown read/adopt/resume path stays unchanged — every in-flight markdown plan still detects, adopts, and resumes; pinned by a detection test over a legacy-folder fixture.

Flow-eval conformance: the flow-eval extension carries a single-phase dd-native builder scenario — a BLIND subject peer (pij) runs the new flow end-to-end on a scaffolded repo, and telemetry-scored assertions prove correct tool use: plan authored as plan.dd.json with no -plan.md, task file JIT-born with done_when + mandatory pressure + satisfies, at least one gate refusal evidenced in telemetry (command_exit gate E-code — tk-7169) followed by a pass, plan validate --complete green before ship-ward departure, states mutated through dd surfaces (never hand-edited generated md).

Scenario prompting/instructions updated to match; scored via harness flow-eval score and ledgered. Multi-phase deferred.

sections.name: risks_assumptions
sections.value:
Standing assumption: R-elegance — when a mechanism can be a convention, it is.

The dd/flow injection seams shipped in 065 accommodate the second gate kind without surface renegotiation beyond the E45x block. The #90 layout amendments (dd pair replaces -plan.md at root; bare-ordinal task dirs) are accepted as STATED amendments in the builder docs, never silent divergence.

Risk detail: see the risks section.

value.question:
ac-7107 non---complete posture (open completables as one summary info line, per-row warnings only under --complete) is a carried LEAN — koala's warning-fatigue proposal, narratively walked with Jordan but not explicitly confirmed.

One-line confirm or veto flips the wording; nothing else depends on it.
value.note: RULED (Jordan, 2026-08-04): "yeah we don't warn" — summary info line only mid-flight; --address (ac-7108) is the on-demand scoped read; per-row accounting reserved for --complete.

value.why: The 2026-08-04 design session (one question at a time, narrative scenarios) played the workshop role; its rulings are the ledger in 065/builder-tuning/notes.md.

value.question: Who closes ACs?
value.answer: Agents — fully autonomous journeys; humans review ACs + linked evidence at the PR stage.

value.question: BP coverage predicate — any incoming link, or only settled assertions?
value.answer: Neither — BP is a toolbelt; the obligation flips to assertions (mandatory pressure), and the toolbelt gates nothing.

value.question: Escape for assertions no instrument checks?
value.answer: pressure: not-applicable — explicit and queryable; silence fails.

value.question: Rel vocabulary governance?
value.answer: Frozen core of five + open namespace (unknown rels behave as ref).

value.question: --complete green semantics?
value.answer: Strict zero warnings; bypass via defended --force (human-authorized, recorded).

value.question: Builder authoring format?
value.answer: Fully dd-native, no dual write path; in future there will not be a -plan.md, just dd. Rebase first (#90 landed in main).

value.question: Probe linking (ACs run probes, go green)?
value.answer: Keep away from it — harness checks fills that role for now; later iteration maybe, not now.

value.effect: Authoritative decisions; RULED items binding; never re-litigated here.
The design doc; promotes to docs/how/dd in ph-7103.
Folded; the load-bearing findings promoted to key_findings.
Confirmed — no mid-flight warns; summary line + --address scoped read; see open_questions receipt.

The flow-eval/telemetry capability arc (034→069), current assertion vocabulary, the four-probe evidence inventory, and the reuse-vs-build delta for the eval scenario; sourced the refusal-evidence and SessionEvidence key findings.

value.notes: No unresolved NEEDS CLARIFICATION; one carried LEAN recorded in open_questions, non-blocking.
dd-core isolation + flow barrel discipline preserved; new seams extend, never bypass.
No accepted ADRs bind this surface.
All required builder-spec sections present as dd sections (domain mode OFF per #90 — Target Domains/Manifest omitted). The schema extension carrying them ships with this plan.
Every phase carries planted-bad/control tasks per the testing strategy.

sections.name: implementation_summary
sections.value:
The dd proof graph shipped in 065 but nothing drives it: no flight plan carries a dd_link, builder authors markdown, and the semantic questions (does this plan's story hang together?) have no surface.

This plan wires the loop end to end — schema features first (rels, buckets, mandatory pressure, satisfies), then the semantic validator, then the flow wiring (gates + dd-native authoring, exiting on the end-to-end dry-run), then one close-out phase: PR surface, corpus/docs upgrade, self-hosting audit, and the blind flow-eval.

The outcome: an autonomous journey whose phase departures are mechanically refused until the documents prove the work, and whose PR hands the human reviewer claims with their evidence one click away.

value.finding: A static flight-plan template cannot bake gate addresses containing phase-N-<kebab-title> slugs it can't know (validation F1).
value.action: Bare-ordinal task dirs for dd-native plans (assets/tasks/phase-N/) — stated amendment to #90; ac-7110.

value.finding: Shipped builder/* schemas declare NO rels; without declaring them the contradiction engine ships inert on every real plan (validation F2).
value.action: ac-7101 declare-clause; tk-7115; schema test pin.

value.finding: E430–E439 AND E440–E449 are both complete allocations; dd-surface.test.ts pins exactly 50 E4xx codes against the manifest (validation F6).
value.action: E450–E459 via surface-manifest renegotiation, inside ph-7101 scope (tk-7125).

value.finding: Flow dd_link addresses anchor at repo root (fromPath: null) — the post-flight archive git mv silently stales them; dd doctor cannot see it (scans only *.dd.json) (validation F8).
value.action: Archive step rewrites dd_link addresses; ac-7113; pinned in tk-7165.

value.finding: 7b post-flight archives the plan folder BEFORE ship — ship must read the corpus from the archive path (validation F7).
Builder detection keys hard on <slug>-plan.md (63 references); deleting the markdown read path strands every in-flight plan (validation F4).
value.action: ac-7115: dd-native is write-path-only; legacy reader retained + pinned (tk-7146).

value.finding: The OD-8 parser allow-list silently drops unknown schema keys — rel will vanish without a parse-layer pin.
value.action: tk-7111; pin in declarations.test.ts/parse.test.ts, never the renderer suite.

value.finding: 18 of 26 exemplar dw- rows lack pressure — the mandatory rule breaks the corpus as-is.
value.action: tk-7161; each row gets a real link or not-applicable; ledger walked leaf-first.

value.finding:
Dogfood (this document): the dd id-prefix registry is a CLI constant (ID_PREFIXES in core/constants.ts) — a schema cannot mint new item kinds, so full-spec sections (key findings, gate rows, open questions) were designed without id fields;
and the builder/plan schema had to be extended with 15 new sections to carry the full builder spec.
value.action: ph-7101 revisits (same phase): either register prefixes in schema declarations or bless id-less rows as the pattern for non-addressable sections; the schema extension ships as part of this plan.

value.finding:
Gate refusals are currently unprovable from evidence — a triple loss: the refusal writes nothing to the flow (pinned P6 invariant, flow-mutations.ts:126-127), outcome-events never reads envelope.error.code, and flow failures collapse to verb 'flow'.

Only a FORCE is durable (dd-gate-override flow event). ac-7117/ac-7118 depend on refusal evidence existing.
value.action: tk-7169: capture envelope.error.code in command_exit (fixed-vocab, privacy-precedented by checks.gates/mark.verdict) — refusal lands in telemetry, the nothing-written flow invariant survives untouched.

value.finding: SessionEvidence deliberately excludes command_exit, file, artifact, and mark events (session-evidence.ts:311-333), and the flow-eval resolvers mirror must stay lock-step (a CLI test asserts it). Any new assertion keying on those needs the single seam widened on both sides.

Dogfood (journey): dd documents have NO writer surface — every structural edit in this plan's own authoring was ad-hoc python read-modify-write, causing the dw-id collisions and stale-sibling risk;
tk-7143's '6/6a mutate states through dd surfaces' implied verbs that do not exist.
value.action: ac-7119 / tk-7128: dd get/set/add/rm + minting, schema-validated before write, auto sibling rebuild; surface renegotiation.

value.title: dd core — relations, buckets, and the semantic validator
value.objective: The schema layer learns rel, the renderer learns the links bucket, the builder/* schemas gain every field this design needs, and harness plan validate grows its opinions.
delivers: dd get/set/add/rm + CLI id minting — built first, used by everything after
rel on link shapes: parse, allow-list, resolved-schema exposure; unknown rel behaves as ref
Frozen-five manifest row + surface test; links bucket + rel labels/filter in graph map
builder/* schema upgrades: done_when, satisfies (array), mandatory pressure + not-applicable, rel declarations everywhere
Synthetic corpus factory + lifecycle-mutation suites; dd validate regression pin
value.key_risks: The OD-8 allow-list silently dropping rel — first task pins it at the parse layer. --address closure semantics — settle in tests before wiring.

value.title: Wire the flow — check-kind gate + dd-native authoring
value.objective: Departure gates on the semantic validator, the template authors every gate, and the builder pipeline authors and mutates dd documents natively while teaching its own tooling.
value.brief:
DdLink check variant behind deps.gate (live evaluation, verbatim-findings refusal, --force records); template/expander emit per-phase completion gates (bare-ordinal addresses) + last-review check gate; pre-JIT target-invalid refusal pinned as intended; barrel discipline extended; renderer/orient/rail surfacing.

Then the prompt-ware: 1b plan authors plan.dd.json (no -plan.md), 5 tasks authors the task file + phase-row link in one stroke, 6/6a mutate states through dd, node instructions[] baked, stage modules teach their seam's commands, legacy read path retained.

EXIT: the scripted end-to-end dry-run (create → JIT → refuse → green → depart), CLI as actor — this phase does not close without it.
delivers: Check-variant model + sanitize + untrusted-reading rules; evaluator behind deps.gate; act wiring
Template/expander gate authoring; pre-JIT refusal pin; dep-cruiser + seam test extension; badge/rail surfacing
1b plan → plan.dd.json + sibling; 5 tasks → task file + link, one stroke; 6/6a dd state mutation
Node instructions[] baked + stage modules teach per-seam commands; legacy read/adopt path retained
value.key_risks: Barrel discipline (flow reaches the validator through an exported seam, never past one). Prompt-ware cannot be compile-checked — the exit dry-run is the proof; keep every module change behind it.

value.title: Close-out — PR surface, corpus, docs, self-hosting audit, flow-eval
value.objective: The human checkpoint sees claims with evidence, the reference corpus and docs tell the truth, and the flow proves itself twice over — self-hosted and blind-evaluated.
value.brief:
Ship renders the dd-derived AC table from the archive path (refuses an unclosed corpus; head-SHA links).

Exemplar upgraded (18 dw rows pressured; satisfies; done_when; leaf-first ledger walk); docs/how/dd chapters + justfile recipes; structural-proof-graph promoted with a signpost; baked docs regenerated; archive-move proof (doctor-clean + dd_link rewrite).

The self-hosting audit (ac-7117) and the single-phase blind flow-eval scenario (ac-7118) close the plan.
delivers: Corpus → PR-body AC table renderer + ship integration (archive path, head-SHA links)
Exemplar schema upgrade; docs/how/dd chapters + recipes; proof-graph promotion; baked docs regen
Self-hosting retrofit audit; flow-eval single-phase scenario, scored + ledgered
value.key_risks: Corpus upgrade ripples basis shas — leaf-first. Broken PR links would discredit the surface on day one.

value.success: Goldens over the exemplar; refuses unclosed corpus.

value.title: Ship stage integration (archive path, head-SHA links)
value.success: Links click through on a real PR.

value.title: docs/how/dd chapters + justfile recipes for new commands
value.success: Every new command has a runnable recipe.

value.title: Promote structural-proof-graph into docs/how/dd
value.success: Links repaired; builder-tuning keeps a signpost.

value.title: Archive-move proof: git mv fixture + dd_link rewrite
Full just checks + warn-trio baseline verification
Self-hosting retrofit + proof: plan 071's corpus fully dd-native
value.success: backpressure + execution-log docs linked from every AC; task files with done_when; rel-typed satisfies; flight-plan gate events show a real refusal and a real pass; plan validate --complete green; doctor-clean.

value.risk: Prompt-ware drift — P4 modules say one thing, the CLI does another.
value.mitigation: Joint-exit dry-run with the CLI as actor; doc-drift checks.

value.risk: --address closure semantics surprise (what counts as in scope).
value.mitigation: Settle in tk-7124's tests first; document the closure rule in the chapter.

value.risk: Corpus upgrade breaks downstream goldens broadly.
value.mitigation: Phase-6 isolation; leaf-first ledger walk; goldens regenerated deliberately, never blindly.

value.risk: Check-gate evaluation cost at every departure.
value.mitigation: Scoped to the last review node only; completion gates stay cheap.
Amendments STATED in builder docs (ac-7110/ac-7113) — divergence is documented, never discovered.

sections.name: execution_guardrails
value: Worked in the s065 worktree/branch (Jordan's call); rebased onto main before drafting; rebuild dist after every rebase or CLI edit (the hook runs THIS worktree's dist — merged-is-not-running, per-checkout variant).
No pushes; no commits until the prime clears the commit path (Jordan, 2026-08-04).
just fix before any push (CI gates on biome).
Frozen surfaces extend only via the one-line manifest renegotiation; the five rels and the E45x block join the manifest on landing.
Historical corpora are never rewritten to satisfy new rules — living corpora upgrade; frozen ones get signposts.
